entry.name: jit.phys.barslide
entry.digest: A bar constraint in a physics world
entry.description: The jit.phys.barslide object constrains attached jit.phys.body objects to rotate and translate around a single axis. Limits and motor forces can be specified for both the linear translation and angular rotation around the constraint. If only a single body is bound, it is constrained to a point in world space.
